stepTitle: The sum of the residuals is $$0$$.
stepBody: The owner collects $$n$$ $$=$$ $$30$$ observations and fits an Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) model with $$29$$ features (e.g., foot traffic, temperature, etc.) with an intercept (30 parameters total). The model is:\n$$\hat{y}_i=\hat{\theta}_0+\hat{\theta}_1x_{i1}+\hat{\theta}_2x_{i2}+\cdot{s}+\hat{\theta}_{29}x_{i29}$$\nWhich of the following is always true?
